rows.text_en: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Marine Pollution Control - Marine Environment Policy Division ), 051-773-5283, 5293

rows.source_ko: 해양수산부 (총괄, 법령개정사항 - 해양환경정책과), 051-773-5289, 5290
rows.text_en: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Overall, Legislative Amendments - Marine Environment Policy Division ), 051-773-5289, 5290

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「해양환경관리법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정하는 것을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Marine Environment Management Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(잔류성오염물질) 「해양환경관리법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제2조제10호에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 것”이란 「잔류성오염물질 관리법」에 따른 잔류성오염물질을 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 24., 2013. 6. 19., 2018. 5. 1., 2026. 10. 6.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Persistent Organic Pollutants) In Subparagraph 10 of Article 2 of the Marine Environment Management Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the term “as prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to persistent organic pollutants under the Persistent Organic Pollutants Management Act. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 19, 2013; May 1, 2018; Oct. 6, 2026>
[Title amended May 1, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(해양시설) 법 제2조제17호에서 “해양수산부령이 정하는 것”이란 별표 1의 시설을 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Marine Facilities) In subparagraph 17 of Article 2 of the Act, “those prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the facilities listed in Annex 1. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013>
Article 4 Deleted <September 22, 2017>

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Marine Environment Monitoring Network) ① The Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Sciencemay establish the following marine environment monitoring networks (hereinafter referred to as the “Marine Environment Monitoring Network”) pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act . <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 23, 2016; Jan. 12, 2017; Sep. 22, 2017; May 1, 2018; Jan. 7, 2021>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Marine Environment Monitoring Network) ① The Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science may establish the following marine environment monitoring networks (hereinafter referred to as the “Marine Environment Monitoring Network”) pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act. <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 23, 2016; Jan. 12, 2017; Sep. 22, 2017; May 1, 2018; Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. Port Environment Monitoring Network
rows.text_en: 1. Port Environment Monitoring Network

rows.source_ko: 2. Coastal Environment Monitoring Network
rows.text_en: 2. Coastal Environment Monitoring Network

rows.source_ko: 3. Environmental Management Area Environmental Monitoring Network
rows.text_en: 3. Environmental Management Area Environmental Monitoring Network

rows.source_ko: 4. Estuary Environmental Monitoring Network
rows.text_en: 4. Estuary Environmental Monitoring Network

rows.source_ko: 5. Marine and Atmospheric Environment Monitoring Network
rows.text_en: 5. Marine and Atmospheric Environment Monitoring Network

rows.source_ko: 6. Automatic Water Quality Monitoring Network for Severely Polluted Sea Areas
rows.text_en: 6. Automatic Water Quality Monitoring Network for Severely Polluted Sea Areas

rows.source_ko: 7. Marine Radioactive Material Monitoring Network
rows.text_en: 7. Marine Radioactive Material Monitoring Network

rows.source_ko: ② When the Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science intends to establish a marine environment monitoring network, he/she shall formulate a plan for the establishment and operation of the network that includes the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. However, regarding the plan for the establishment and operation of the marine radioactive material monitoring network, he/she shall consult with the Nuclear Safety and Security Commission in advance. <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Jan. 12, 2017; Sep. 22, 2017; May 1, 2018; Jan. 7, 2021>
rows.text_en: ② When the Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science intends to establish a marine environment monitoring network, he/she shall formulate a plan for the establishment and operation of the network that includes the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. However, regarding the plan for the establishment and operation of the marine radioactive material monitoring network, he/she shall consult with the Nuclear Safety and Security Commission in advance. <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Jan. 12, 2017; Sep. 22, 2017; May 1, 2018; Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. Period and Frequency of Surveys
rows.text_en: 1. Period and Frequency of Surveys

rows.source_ko: 2. Measurement Location and Location Map
rows.text_en: 2. Measurement Location and Location Map

rows.source_ko: 3. Measurement Items and Methods
rows.text_en: 3. Measurement Items and Methods

rows.source_ko: 4. Classification of Sea Areas and Types of Measurement Networks
rows.text_en: 4. Classification of Sea Areas and Types of Measurement Networks

rows.source_ko: 5. Other matters necessary for the composition and operation of the marine environment monitoring network
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters necessary for the composition and operation of the marine environment monitoring network

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall make a public announcement when the plan for the composition and operation of the marine environment monitoring network under Paragraph 2 is established or amended . <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Sep. 22, 2017; Jan. 7, 2021>
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall make a public announcement when the plan for the composition and operation of the marine environment monitoring network under Paragraph 2 is established or amended . <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Sep. 22, 2017; Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ④ The Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science shall evaluate the results of the operation of the marine environment monitoring network annually. <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Jan. 7, 2021>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science shall evaluate the results of the operation of the marine environment monitoring network annually. <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: Article 6 (Marine Environment Information Network) ① Deleted <September 22, 2017>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Marine Environment Information Network) ① Deleted <September 22, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② The Chairperson of the Korea Marine Environment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the “Korea Marine Environment Corporation”) pursuant to Article 96 , Paragraph 1 of the Act may, upon request by a person using the Marine Environment Information Network (hereinafter referred to as the “Marine Environment Information Network”) pursuant to Article 11 of the Act , provide for the provision of basic data for marine environment information when providing marine environment information pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Act. However, information subject to non-disclosure pursuant to Article 9 of the Act on Disclosure of Information by Public Institutions shall be excluded. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 19, 2013; Sep. 22, 2017; May 1, 2018; Dec. 28, 2023>
rows.text_en: ② The Chairperson of the Korea Marine Environment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the “Korea Marine Environment Corporation”) pursuant to Article 96 , Paragraph 1 of the Act may, upon request by a person using the Marine Environment Information Network (hereinafter referred to as the “Marine Environment Information Network”) pursuant to Article 11 of the Act , provide for the provision of basic data for marine environment information when providing marine environment information pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Act. However, information subject to non-disclosure pursuant to Article 9 of the Act on Disclosure of Information by Public Institutions shall be excluded. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 19, 2013; Sep. 22, 2017; May 1, 2018; Dec. 28, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may have the President of the Korea Marine Environment Corporation carry out projects such as the analysis and evaluation of marine environment information to enhance the utilization of the marine environment information network. <Amended June 19, 2013; September 22, 2017; May 1, 2018>
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may have the President of the Korea Marine Environment Corporation carry out projects such as the analysis and evaluation of marine environment information to enhance the utilization of the marine environment information network. <Amended June 19, 2013; September 22, 2017; May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ④ Matters necessary for detailed methods of establishment and operation, etc. of the Marine Environment Information Network shall be separately determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries . <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 19, 2013>
rows.text_en: ④ Matters necessary for detailed methods of establishment and operation, etc. of the Marine Environment Information Network shall be separately determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries . <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 19, 2013>

rows.source_ko: Article 7 (Quality Control) ① The Chairperson of the Korea Marine Environment Management Corporation may conduct quality control pursuant to Article 12 , Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “quality control”) on measurement and analysis institutions (hereinafter referred to as “measurement and analysis institutions”) pursuant to Article 7 of the Enforcement Decree of the Marine Environment Management Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) (hereinafter referred to as “measurement and analysis institutions”) every year (every three years for measurement and analysis institutionscertified pursuant to Article 13 of the Act ). <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 23, 2016; Sep. 22, 2017; May 1, 2018>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Quality Control) ① The Chairperson of the Korea Marine Environment Management Corporation may conduct quality control pursuant to Article 12 , Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “quality control”) on measurement and analysis institutions (hereinafter referred to as “measurement and analysis institutions”) pursuant to Article 7 of the Enforcement Decree of the Marine Environment Management Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) (hereinafter referred to as “measurement and analysis institutions”) every year (every three years for measurement and analysis institutionscertified pursuant to Article 13 of the Act ). <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 23, 2016; Sep. 22, 2017; May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② The Chairperson of the Korea Marine Environment Corporation shall analyze the results of the quality control implemented pursuant to Paragraph 1 and make them public by the end of February of the following year. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Sep. 22, 2017; May 1, 2018>
rows.text_en: ② The Chairperson of the Korea Marine Environment Corporation shall analyze the results of the quality control implemented pursuant to Paragraph 1 and make them public by the end of February of the following year. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Sep. 22, 2017; May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may take the following measures against any institution that, as a result of evaluating the measurement and analysis capabilities of such institutions, fails to meet the standards under Article 8 , Paragraph 1. <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013>
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may take the following measures against any institution that, as a result of evaluating the measurement and analysis capabilities of such institutions, fails to meet the standards under Article 8 , Paragraph 1. <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. Order to attend training on the relevant measurement and analysis items at an institution designated by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries
rows.text_en: 1. Order to attend training on the relevant measurement and analysis items at an institution designated by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries

rows.source_ko: 2. Implementation of on-site guidance
rows.text_en: 2. Implementation of on-site guidance

rows.source_ko: 3. Improvement and supplementation of related equipment and devices
rows.text_en: 3. Improvement and supplementation of related equipment and devices

rows.source_ko: 4. Order for other necessary measures
rows.text_en: 4. Order for other necessary measures

rows.source_ko: ④ Matters necessary for the evaluation and measures under Paragraph 3 shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries . <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013>
rows.text_en: ④ Matters necessary for the evaluation and measures under Paragraph 3 shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries . <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: Article 7-2 (Quality Control Standards) ① When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries intends to establish quality control standards pursuant to Article 12-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “quality control standards”), he/she shall consider the state of the marine environment and the purpose of the marine environment survey for each measurement and analysis item.
rows.text_en: Article 7-2 (Quality Control Standards) ① When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries intends to establish quality control standards pursuant to Article 12-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “quality control standards”), he/she shall consider the state of the marine environment and the purpose of the marine environment survey for each measurement and analysis item.

rows.source_ko: ② 정도관리기준에는 측정ㆍ분석능력의 평가방법 및 측정ㆍ분석과 관련된 자료의 검증방법 등의 내용이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Quality control standards shall include content such as evaluation methods for measurement and analysis capabilities and verification methods for data related to measurement and analysis.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 22, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의3(정도관리계획의 수립 등) ① 영 제7조의2에 따른 해양환경종합조사 실시기관(이하 “조사기관”이라 한다)은 법 제12조의3제1항에 따라 다음 각 호의 기준을 고려하여 정도관리계획을 수립하여야 하고, 수립된 정도관리계획에 대하여 해당 조사를 실시하기 전까지 해양수산부장관의 승인을 받아야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-3 (Establishment of Quality Control Plan, etc.) ① An agency conducting a comprehensive marine environment survey pursuant to Article 7-2 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “survey agency”) shall establish a quality control plan in consideration of the standards in each of the following subparagraphs pursuant to Article 12-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act, and shall obtain approval from the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries regarding the established quality control plan before conducting the relevant survey.

rows.source_ko: 1. 측정ㆍ분석과 관련된 자료가 해양환경정보망에 활용될 수 있을 것
rows.text_en: 1. Data related to measurement and analysis can be utilized in the marine environment information network.

rows.source_ko: 2. 정도관리기준에 따를 것
rows.text_en: 2. Comply with quality control standards

rows.source_ko: 3. 정도관리를 위한 교육의 실시계획을 포함할 것
rows.text_en: 3. Include a plan for implementing training for quality control.

rows.source_ko: ② 조사기관은 관련 조사를 완료한 때에 지체없이 제1항에 따라 승인받은 정도관리계획의 이행 현황을 해양수산부장관에게 보고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the investigation agency completes the relevant investigation, it shall report the status of implementation of the quality control plan approved pursuant to Paragraph 1 to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries without delay.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 22, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(측정ㆍ분석능력 인증) ① 법 제13조제1항에서 “해양수산부령이 정하는 측정ㆍ분석의 기준”이란 해양수산부장관이 숙련도평가와 현장평가로 나누어 정하는 기준을 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2011. 9. 29., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Certification of Measurement and Analysis Capability) ① In Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the term “standards for measurement and analysis prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to standards determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, divided into proficiency assessment and on-site assessment. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제13조제2항 단서에서 “해양수산부령이 정하는 중요 사항이 변경되는 경우”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우를 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ② In the proviso to Article 13, Paragraph 2 of the Act, the phrase “cases where important matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries are changed” refers to any of the cases falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 상호 또는 시험실 소재지가 변경되는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In case of a change in the company name or laboratory location

rows.source_ko: 2. 측정방법, 측정원리나 측정항목이 변경되는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. When the measurement method, measurement principle, or measurement item is changed

rows.source_ko: 3. 측정기기의 기능이나 성능에 영향을 미치는 외관이나 내부구조 (운용프로그램을 포함한다)가 변경되는 경우
rows.text_en: 3. In cases where the external appearance or internal structure (including the operating program) that affects the function or performance of the measuring instrument is changed

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제13조제4항에 따라 측정ㆍ분석능력인증을 받으려는 자는 별지 제1호서식의 해양환경 측정ㆍ분석능력 인증신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 해양수산부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. 이 경우 해양수산부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우에 한정한다) 및 사업자등록증명을 각각 확인하여야 하며, 신청인이 사업자등록증명의 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 해당 서류를 제출하도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2011. 4. 11., 2011. 9. 29., 2012. 6. 27., 2013. 3. 24., 2016. 12. 23., 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ③ Any person who intends to obtain certification of measurement and analysis capability pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries an application for certification of marine environment measurement and analysis capability in the form of Annex No. 1 , attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. In this case, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration (limited to cases involving corporations) and the Certificate of Business Registration, respectively, through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act; and if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the Certificate of Business Registration, the Minister shall require the submission of the relevant document. <Amended Apr. 11, 2011; Sep. 29, 2011; Jun. 27, 2012; Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 23, 2016; Jun. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 측정ㆍ분석 장비 및 설비의 보유현황에 관한 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents regarding the current status of measurement and analysis equipment and facilities

rows.source_ko: 2. 측정ㆍ분석 인력의 보유현황에 관한 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents regarding the current status of measurement and analysis personnel

rows.source_ko: 3. 측정ㆍ분석 실험실의 구조 및 환경 조건에 관한 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents regarding the structure and environmental conditions of the measurement and analysis laboratory

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 제1호부터 제3호까지의 설비, 인력 및 실험실이 제1항에 따른 기준에 적합함을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Other documents proving that the facilities, personnel, and laboratories referred to in subparagraphs 1 through 3 comply with the standards under paragraph 1

rows.source_ko: ④ 해양수산부장관은 제3항에 따라 측정ㆍ분석능력 인증을 신청한 기관이 제1항에 따른 기준에 적합하다고 인정하면 별지 제2호서식의 해양환경 측정ㆍ분석능력 인증서를 신청인에게 발급하여야 한다. <개정 2011. 9. 29., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ④ If the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries recognizes that an institution applying for certification of measurement and analysis capability pursuant to Paragraph 3 complies with the standards under Paragraph 1, the Minister shall issue a Certificate of Marine Environment Measurement and Analysis Capability in the form of Annex 2 to the applicant. <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제8조의2(환경관리해역기본계획 등의 공표) 해양수산부장관은 법 제17조제2항에 따라 환경관리해역기본계획 및 해역별 관리계획을 수립한 때에는 관보 또는 해양수산부 인터넷 홈페이지에 게재하는 방법으로 공표해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8-2 (Publication of Basic Plan for Environmentally Managed Sea Areas, etc.) When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries establishes the Basic Plan for Environmentally Managed Sea Areas and management plans for each sea area pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 2 of the Act, he/she shall publish them by posting them in the Official Gazette or on the website of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries.
[This Article Newly Inserted July 9, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(해양환경개선조치) ① 법 제18조제1항제4호에서 “해양수산부령이 정하는 조치”란 다음 각 호의 조치를 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Measures for the Improvement of the Marine Environment) ① The term “measures prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” in Article 18, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Act refers to the measures set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 연안습지정화, 연약지반 보강 등 해양환경복원사업의 실시
rows.text_en: 1. Implementation of marine environment restoration projects, such as coastal wetland purification and soft ground reinforcement
2. Deleted <December 4, 2020>
3. Deleted <December 4, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 해양수산부장관이 필요하다고 인정하는 조치
rows.text_en: 4. Other measures deemed necessary by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries

rows.source_ko: ② 지방해양수산청장은 법 제18조제3항에 따라 해양환경의 오염원에 관한 조사를 할 때에는 공장밀집지역 또는 공업지역의 주변해역, 양식장 밀집해역 및 항만 등 해양오염이 발생할 우려가 높은 장소를 우선적으로 선정하여 조사하되, 해양환경의 오염원으로부터 영향을 받는 해역의 환경현황 및 오염도를 함께 조사하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2012. 11. 29., 2015. 1. 8.>
rows.text_en: ② When the Head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office conducts an investigation into sources of pollution of the marine environment pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 3 of the Act , he/she shall prioritize the selection of locations with a high risk of marine pollution, such as sea areas surrounding densely populated factory or industrial zones, sea areas densely populated with aquaculture farms, and ports, and shall simultaneously investigate the environmental status and pollution levels of sea areas affected by the sources of pollution of the marine environment. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Nov. 29, 2012; Jan. 8, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따른 해양환경의 오염원 및 오염도 조사방법ㆍ절차 등에 필요한 사항은 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ③ Matters necessary for the methods and procedures, etc., for investigating sources of pollution and pollution levels of the marine environment pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall be determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries and announced by public notice . <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제18조제5항에 따른 오염물질 유입ㆍ확산방지시설의 설치방법 및 오염물질의 수거ㆍ처리방법은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2012. 11. 29., 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 6. 28., 2021. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The methods for installing facilities to prevent the inflow and diffusion of pollutants and the methods for collecting and treating pollutants pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 5 of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Nov. 29, 2012; Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 28, 2017; Jun. 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 부유차단막 또는 수질오염 방지막은 부유물질의 확산을 방지할 수 있도록 해야 하며, 기상변화 등에 대비할 수 있도록 설치한다.
rows.text_en: 1. Floating barriers or water pollution barriers must be installed to prevent the spread of floating substances and to prepare for weather changes, etc.
2. Deleted <December 4, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시하는 방법에 따른다.
rows.text_en: 3. Other methods determined and announced by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall apply.

rows.source_ko: 제10조(해양환경개선부담금의 부과ㆍ납부) ① 영 제26조제1항에 따른 해양환경개선부담금 납부고지는 별지 제3호서식에 따른다. 다만, 정보통신망으로 납부고지를 하는 경우의 납부고지방법은 해양수산부장관이 따로 정한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2010. 1. 12., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Imposition and Payment of Marine Environment Improvement Charges) ① The notice of payment of marine environment improvement charges pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form. However, in cases where the notice of payment is made via an information and communications network, the method of the notice of payment shall be separately determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Jan. 12, 2010; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제27조제1항에 따른 부담금분할납부신청서는 별지 제4호서식에 따르고, 같은 조 제2항에 따른 부담금분할납부 허가 여부의 통지는 별지 제5호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The application for installment payment of the levy pursuant to Article 27 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form, and the notification of whether or not to permit installment payment of the levy pursuant to Paragraph 2 of the same Article shall be in accordance with Form No. 5 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제29조제2항에 따른 해양환경개선부담금의 조정부과 또는 환급의 통지는 별지 제6호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The notification of the adjustment, imposition, or refund of the marine environment improvement charge pursuant to Article 29, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제30조제1항에 따라 해양환경개선부담금의 조정을 신청하려는 자는 별지 제7호서식의 해양환경개선부담금 조정신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 조정신청의 사유를 입증하는 서류를 첨부하여 지방해양수산청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 1. 12., 2014. 11. 19., 2015. 1. 8.>
rows.text_en: ④ Any person who intends to apply for the adjustment of the Marine Environment Improvement Charge pursuant to Article 30, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an Application for Adjustment of the Marine Environment Improvement Charge ( Form No. 7 ) (including an application in the form of an electronic document) to the Head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office, attaching documents proving the grounds for the adjustment application. <Amended Jan. 12, 2010; Nov. 19, 2014; Jan. 8, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 영 제32조의2에 따른 독촉은 별지 제8호서식에 따른다. <개정 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The demand for payment pursuant to Article 32-2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 of the Attached Form . <Amended May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(폐기물의 배출허용기준) ① 삭제 <2020. 12. 4.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Permissible Emission Standards for Waste) ① Deleted <December 4, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제22조제2항제1호에 따라 해양시설 또는 영 제34조에 따른 해양공간(이하 “해양시설등”이라 한다)에서 발생하는 폐기물은 「해양폐기물 및 해양오염퇴적물 관리법」 제7조제2항에서 정하는 방법에 따라 배출할 수 있다. 다만, 해양시설등의 일상생활에서 발생하는 폐기물의 해역별 배출기준은 별표 4와 같다. <개정 2020. 12. 4.>
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 22, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Act , waste generated in marine facilities or marine spaces pursuant to Article 34 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as “marine facilities, etc.”) may be discharged in accordance with the methods prescribed in Article 7, Paragraph 2 of the Marine Waste and Marine Pollution Sediment Management Act . However, the discharge standards by sea area for waste generated from daily life in marine facilities, etc. are as set forth in Annex 4. <Amended Dec. 4, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제22조제2항제2호에 따라 해양시설등에서 발생하는 기름 및 유해액체물질을 처리하는 기준과 방법은 별표 5와 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The standards and methods for treating oil and hazardous liquid substances generated from marine facilities, etc., pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Table 5 .

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제22조제3항제3호에 따라 해양시설등의 오염사고에 있어서는 오염사고에 대처할 목적으로 오염으로 인한 피해를 최소화하기 위해 사용되는 기름, 유해액체물질 또는 이들 물질을 함유한 혼합물 등을 해양에 배출할 수 있다. <개정 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ④ Pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 3 of the Act , in the event of a pollution accident involving marine facilities, etc., oil, hazardous liquid substances, or mixtures containing such substances may be discharged into the ocean for the purpose of responding to the pollution accident and minimizing damage caused by pollution. <Amended Jan. 7, 2021>
Article 12 Deleted <December 4, 2020>
Article 13 Deleted <December 4, 2020>
Article 14 Deleted <December 4, 2020>
Article 15 Deleted <December 4, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 제16조(해역관리청의 조사ㆍ측정활동 내용) ① 법 제24조제2항에서 “해양수산부령이 정하는 조사ㆍ측정활동”이란 다음 각 호의 사항에 대한 조사ㆍ측정활동을 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Contents of Investigation and Measurement Activities of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Agency) ① In Article 24, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the term “investigation and measurement activities prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to investigation and measurement activities concerning the matters of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013>
1. Deleted <December 4, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 조사대상의 위치 및 규모 등 이용현황
rows.text_en: 2. Usage status of the relevant survey subject, including location and scale

rows.source_ko: 3. 해당 해양공간 인근의 오염방지시설의 위치, 오염방지시설의 규모, 처리량 등 오염방지시설현황
rows.text_en: 3. Status of pollution prevention facilities near the relevant marine space, including location, scale, and throughput.

rows.source_ko: 4. 수질오염도, 퇴적물오염도, 오염원의 분포현황 등 오염현황
rows.text_en: 4. Current pollution status, including water quality, sediment pollution, and distribution of pollution sources

rows.source_ko: 5. 해양환경 및 해양생태계에 미치는 영향
rows.text_en: 5. Impact on the marine environment and marine ecosystem

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 해양오염방지를 위하여 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters necessary for the prevention of marine pollution

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 조사ㆍ측정방법 및 절차 등 필요한 사항은 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ② Necessary matters, such as investigation and measurement methods and procedures pursuant to Paragraph 1, shall be determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries and announced by public notice . <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제17조(해양시설의 신고 등) ① 해양시설의 소유자(설치ㆍ운영자를 포함하며, 그 시설을 임대하는 경우에는 시설임차인을 말한다. 이하 같다)는 법 제33조제1항 전단에 따라 해양시설의 신고를 하려는 경우에는 별지 제12호서식의 해양시설 최초신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2010. 1. 12., 2011. 4. 11., 2015. 1. 8., 2017. 6. 28., 2018. 5. 1., 2024. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Reporting of Marine Facilities, etc.) ① When an owner of a marine facility (including the installer and operator, and in cases where the facility is leased, the lessee; hereinafter the same) intends to report the marine facility pursuant to the first part of Article 33, Paragraph 1 of the Act, he/she shall submit the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs attached to the Initial Report of Marine Facilities in Form No. 12 of the Appendix to the Head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office or the Governor of a City or Province. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Jan. 12, 2010; Apr. 11, 2011; Jan. 8, 2015; Jun. 28, 2017; May 1, 2018; Jun. 28, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양시설의 설치명세서와 그 도면 및 위치도(축척 2만 5천분의 1의 지형도를 말한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Specifications for the installation of marine facilities, drawings thereof, and location map (referring to a topographic map with a scale of 1:25,000)

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제36조에 따른 해양시설해양오염방지관리인의 임명확인서(별표 1 제1호의 시설인 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Confirmation of appointment of the marine facility pollution prevention manager pursuant to Article 36 of the Act ( limited to cases of facilities listed in Item 1 of Annex 1)

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제35조에 따른 해양시설오염비상계획서(제19조제1항에 따른 해양시설인 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Marine Facility Pollution Emergency Plan pursuant to Article 35 of the Act ( limited to cases of marine facilities pursuant to Article 19 , Paragraph 1 )

rows.source_ko: ② 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 제1항에 따른 신고를 받으면 별지 제13호서식의 해양시설 신고대장에 적고, 별지 제14호서식의 해양시설 신고증명서를 발급하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2010. 1. 12., 2015. 1. 8., 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving a report pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office or the Governor of a City or Province shall record it in the Marine Facility Report Register in Annex 13 and issue a Marine Facility Report Certificate in Annex 14. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Jan. 12, 2010; Jan. 8, 2015; Jun. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제33조제1항 후단에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 중요한 내용의 변경”이란 다음 각 호를 말한다. <신설 2017. 6. 28., 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ In the latter part of Article 33, Paragraph 1 of the Act , “change of important contents prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to each of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added June 28, 2017; May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양시설의 소유자(사업장의 명칭 및 대표자를 포함한다)의 변경
rows.text_en: 1. Change of owner of marine facilities (including the name of the business site and the representative)

rows.source_ko: 2. 해양시설(별표 1 제1호가목의 시설인 경우에 한정한다)의 설치 장소의 변경
rows.text_en: 2. Change of installation location of marine facilities ( limited to facilities under Item 1, Subparagraph (a) of Annex 1)

rows.source_ko: 3. 해양시설(별표 1 제1호가목의 시설인 경우에 한정한다)의 규모의 변경(100분의 50 이상 증가한 경우에 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Change in the size of marine facilities ( limited to facilities under Item 1, Subparagraph (a) of Annex 1) (limited to cases where it has increased by 50 percent or more)

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제33조제1항 후단에 따라 해양시설의 변경신고를 하려는 자는 변경사유가 발생한 날부터 30일 이내에 별지 제12호서식의 해양시설 변경신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다. <신설 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ④ Any person who intends to report a change to a marine facility pursuant to the latter part of Article 33, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit a report on the change to a marine facility in the form of Annex No. 12 (including a report in the form of an electronic document) to the head of the regional maritime affairs and fisheries office or the mayor/governor of a city/province within 30 days from the date the cause for the change occurred, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제2항에 따른 해양시설 신고증명서
rows.text_en: 1. Certificate of notification of marine facilities pursuant to Paragraph 2

rows.source_ko: 2. 변경내용을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving the changes

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 제4항에 따른 변경신고를 받으면 별지 제13호서식의 해양시설 신고대장 및 별지 제14호서식의 해양시설 신고증명서 뒤쪽에 각각 그 변경내용을 적은 후 해양시설 신고증명서를 발급하여야 한다. <신설 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Upon receiving a report of change pursuant to Paragraph 4, the Head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office or the Governor of a City or Province shall record the details of the change on the back of the Marine Facility Report Register (Form No. 13) and the Marine Facility Report Certificate ( Form No. 14), respectively, and then issue a Marine Facility Report Certificate. <Newly added June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제2항 또는 제5항에 따른 해양시설 신고증명서를 잃어버리거나 헐어서 못쓰게 된 자는 별지 제15호서식의 해양시설 신고증명서 재발급신청서를 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여 재발급받을 수 있다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2010. 1. 12., 2015. 1. 8., 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Any person who has lost or damaged the Certificate of Reporting of Marine Facilities under Paragraph 2 or 5, rendering it unusable, may have it reissued by submitting the Application for Reissuance of the Certificate of Reporting of Marine Facilities (Form No. 15) to the Head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office or the Governor of a City or Province. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Jan. 12, 2010; Jan. 8, 2015; Jun. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 제1항에 따라 해양시설의 신고를 한 자가 해양시설을 폐업하려는 경우에는 별지 제16호서식의 해양시설 폐업신고서에 해양시설 신고증명서를 첨부하여 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2010. 1. 12., 2015. 1. 8., 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ If a person who has reported a marine facility pursuant to Paragraph 1 intends to close the marine facility, they shall submit a report on the closure of the marine facility in the form of Annex 16, attached with the certificate of report of the marine facility, to the head of the regional maritime affairs and fisheries office or the mayor/governor of the city/province. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Jan. 12, 2010; Jan. 8, 2015; Jun. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제18조(해양시설오염물질기록부) ① 법 제34조제1항에서 “해양수산부령이 정하는 해양시설”이란 별표 1 제1호가목의 시설을 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Record Book of Pollutants from Marine Facilities) ① In Article 34, Paragraph 1 of the Act, “marine facilities prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the facilities listed in Item 1, Subparagraph (a) of Annex 1. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제34조에 따른 해양시설오염물질기록부(이하 “해양시설오염물질기록부”라 한다)에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 적어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The marine facility pollutant record book pursuant to Article 34 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “marine facility pollutant record book”) shall record the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 기름 및 유해액체물질의 사용량과 선적 및 반입에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the usage of oil and hazardous liquid substances, as well as their shipment and import

rows.source_ko: 2. 유성혼합물 또는 유해액체물질 세정수의 처리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the treatment of wash water for oily mixtures or hazardous liquid substances

rows.source_ko: 3. 해양시설의 운영과정에서 발생되는 오염물질 처리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the treatment of pollutants generated during the operation of marine facilities

rows.source_ko: ③ 해양시설오염물질기록부는 별지 제17호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The marine facility pollutant record book is as in Form No. 17 of the attached document .

rows.source_ko: 제19조(해양시설오염비상계획서) ① 법 제35조에 따라 해양시설오염비상계획서(이하 “해양시설오염비상계획서”라 한다)를 갖추어야 하는 해양시설은 별표 1 제1호가목 또는 나목의 시설 중 합계용량 300킬로리터 이상인 시설로 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 1., 2024. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Marine Facility Pollution Emergency Plan) ① Marine facilities required to be equipped with a Marine Facility Pollution Emergency Plan (hereinafter referred to as the “Marine Facility Pollution Emergency Plan”) pursuant to Article 35 of the Act shall be those facilities with a total capacity of 300 kiloliters or more among the facilities listed in Subparagraph (a) or (b) of Item 1 of Annex 1. <Amended May 1, 2018; June 28, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 해양시설오염비상계획서에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2011. 9. 29., 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Marine Facility Pollution Emergency Plan shall include the following matters: <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양시설의 위치, 규모, 소유자(사업장의 명칭 및 대표자를 포함한다) 및 관리자에 대한 정보(군사시설의 경우에는 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Information regarding the location, size, owner (including the name of the business and the representative), and manager of the marine facility (excluding military facilities)

rows.source_ko: 2. 기름 또는 유해액체물질 유출사고 발생 시 해양시설의 관리자가 하여야 할 신고 및 보고의 절차에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the procedures for reporting and notification that the manager of a marine facility must follow in the event of an oil or hazardous liquid spill accident

rows.source_ko: 3. 기름 또는 유해액체물질 유출을 줄이기 위하여 해양시설의 종사자가 하여야 할 방제조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning pollution control measures to be taken by personnel of marine facilities to reduce oil or hazardous liquid spills

rows.source_ko: 4. 해양시설의 주요설비, 시설구조도면 및 주요배관장치의 배치도면
rows.text_en: 4. Major equipment of the marine facility, structural drawings of the facility, and layout drawings of the major piping systems

rows.source_ko: 5. 해양시설 종사자에 대한 방제교육ㆍ훈련에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning pollution control education and training for personnel at marine facilities

rows.source_ko: 6. 해양시설 주변해역의 조류, 환경 등 해역특성에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning sea area characteristics, such as currents and the environment, in the waters surrounding marine facilities

rows.source_ko: 7. 기름 또는 유해액체물질 유출사고 예방 및 점검에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the prevention and inspection of oil or hazardous liquid spill accidents

rows.source_ko: 8. 해양오염사고 방제에 필요한 방제조직, 방제장비ㆍ자재 현황 및 동원체계
rows.text_en: 8. Status of response organizations, equipment and materials, and mobilization system required for marine pollution accident response

rows.source_ko: 9. 해양시설 오염사고 규모별 방제조치계획
rows.text_en: 9. Pollution Response Plans by Scale of Marine Facility Accidents

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제35조제1항 본문에 따라 해양시설오염비상계획서의 검인을 받으려는 자는 별지 제18호서식의 해양시설오염비상계획서 검인신청서에 해당 해양시설오염비상계획서를 첨부하여 해양경찰서장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 6. 19., 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 28.>
rows.text_en: ③ Any person who intends to obtain verification of a marine facility pollution emergency plan pursuant to the main clause of Article 35, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for verification of a marine facility pollution emergency plan in the form of Annex 18 to the head of the Korea Coast Guard station, attaching the relevant marine facility pollution emergency plan. <Amended June 19, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제35조제2항에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 중요한 사항을 변경하려는 경우”란 다음 각 호의 경우를 말한다. <개정 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ In Article 35, Paragraph 2 of the Act , “cases where important matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries are to be changed” refers to any of the following cases: <Amended May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양시설의 소유자(사업장의 명칭 및 대표자를 포함한다) 및 관리자에 대한 정보의 변경
rows.text_en: 1. Change of information regarding the owner (including the name of the business site and the representative) and manager of the marine facility

rows.source_ko: 2. 해양시설의 위치의 변경
rows.text_en: 2. Change of location of marine facilities

rows.source_ko: 3. 해양시설의 규모의 100분의 30 이상의 증가
rows.text_en: 3. An increase of 30% or more in the scale of marine facilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 해양시설의 주요설비, 시설구조도면 및 주요배관장치의 100분의 10 이상의 변경
rows.text_en: 4. Changes of 10% or more of the major equipment, structural drawings, and major piping systems of the marine facility

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제35조제2항에 따라 변경검인을 받으려는 자는 별지 제18호서식의 해양시설오염비상계획서 변경검인신청서에 변경된 해양시설오염비상계획서를 첨부하여 변경 사유가 발생한 날부터 30일 이내에 해양경찰서장에게 제출하여야 한다. <신설 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Any person who intends to obtain verification of a change pursuant to Article 35, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit an Application for Verification of a Change to the Marine Facility Pollution Emergency Plan (Form No. 18) to the Head of the Coast Guard Station within 30 days from the date the cause for the change occurred, attaching the amended Marine Facility Pollution Emergency Plan. <Newly added May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 해양경찰서장은 제3항에 따른 검인신청 또는 제5항에 따른 변경검인신청이 있는 경우 적합하다고 인정하면 해당 해양시설오염비상계획서에 별표 9의 검인표시를 하여 신청인에게 내주어야 한다. <신설 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ In the event of an application for verification pursuant to Paragraph 3 or an application for verification of modification pursuant to Paragraph 5, if the Head of the Maritime Police Station deems it appropriate, he/she shall affix the verification mark specified in Annex 9 to the relevant Marine Facility Pollution Emergency Plan and issue it to the applicant. <Newly added May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 제20조(해양오염방지관리인을 두어야 하는 해양시설) 법 제36조제1항에서 “해양수산부령이 정하는 해양시설”이란 별표 1 제1호의 시설을 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Marine Facilities Requiring the Appointment of a Marine Pollution Prevention Manager) In Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the term “marine facilities prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the facilities listed in Item 1 of Annex 1. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제20조의2(해양시설 해양오염방지관리인 임명 신고) 법 제36조제1항에 따라 해양오염방지관리인을 임명한 해양시설의 소유자가 같은 조 제2항에 따라 그 사실을 신고하려는 때에는 다음 각 호의 서류를 해양경찰서장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20-2 (Reporting of Appointment of Marine Pollution Prevention Manager for Marine Facilities) When the owner of a marine facility who has appointed a marine pollution prevention manager pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Act intends to report such fact pursuant to Paragraph 2 of the same Article , he/she shall submit the following documents to the head of the Korea Coast Guard.

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양오염방지관리인의 임명 확인서
rows.text_en: 1. Confirmation of Appointment of Marine Pollution Prevention Manager

rows.source_ko: 2. 해양오염방지관리인의 자격을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving the qualifications of the marine pollution prevention manager

[This Article was newly added on Jan. 7, 2021.]
[Formerly Article 20-2 was moved to Article 20-3 <Jan. 7, 2021>]

rows.source_ko: 제20조의3(해양시설의 안전점검) ① 법 제36조의2제1항에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 해양시설”이란 별표 1 제1호가목 및 나목의 시설을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20-3 (Safety Inspection of Marine Facilities) ① In Article 36-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , “marine facilities prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries”refers to the facilities listed in Subparagraphs (a) and (b) of Item 1 of Annex 1 .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제36조의2제1항에 따른 안전점검(이하 “안전점검”이라 한다)의 실시 시기ㆍ방법 및 결과보고는 별표 9의2에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The timing, method, and result reporting of safety inspections (hereinafter referred to as “safety inspections”) pursuant to Article 36-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be in accordance with Annex 9-2 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제36조의2제2항에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 중대한 결함”이란 다음 각 호의 결함을 말한다. <신설 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 36-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act , “serious defects prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to any of the defects listed in the following subparagraphs. <Newly added May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양시설의 침하 또는 균열
rows.text_en: 1. Subsidence or cracking of marine facilities

rows.source_ko: 2. 해저송유관, 호스, 저장탱크, 돌핀 또는 원유송유용 부이의 결함
rows.text_en: 2. Defects in submarine oil pipelines, hoses, storage tanks, dolphins, or crude oil transport buoys

[This Article was newly added on Sep. 17, 2014]
[Moved from Article 20-2 on Jan. 7, 2021>]

rows.source_ko: 제21조(해양시설에서 발생하는 오염물질의 수거ㆍ처리) ① 해양시설에서 발생하는 오염물질로서 법 제37조제1항에 따라 수거ㆍ처리하게 해야 하는 물질은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2014. 9. 17., 2018. 5. 1., 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Collection and Treatment of Pollutants Generated from Marine Facilities) ① Pollutants generated from marine facilitiesthat must be collected and treated pursuant to Article 37, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows: <Amended Sep. 17, 2014; May 1, 2018; Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 폐기물
rows.text_en: 1. Waste

rows.source_ko: 2. 기름(해양시설의 소유자가 스스로의 설비나 장비를 이용하여 유분 성분이 100만분의 15 이하가 되도록 처리하는 경우는 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Oil (excluding cases where the owner of the offshore facility treats it using their own facilities or equipment so that the oil content is 15 parts per million or less)

rows.source_ko: 3. 유해액체물질(해양시설의 소유자가 스스로의 설비나 장비를 이용하여 「물환경보전법 시행규칙」 별표 13 제1호가목2)에 따른 가지역에 적용하는 같은 표 제2호 항목별 배출허용기준 이하로 처리하는 경우는 제외한다) 또는 포장유해물질 잔류물
rows.text_en: 3. Hazardous liquid substances (excluding cases where the owner of a marine facility treats them using their own facilities or equipment to a level below the permissible discharge standards for each item in Item 2 of Annex 13, applicable to Area (a) under Annex 13 of the Enforcement Rule of the Water Environment Preservation Act) or residues of packaged hazardous substances

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제37조제1항 각 호의 자는 해양시설로부터 오염물질을 수거ㆍ처리하는 경우에는 해당 해양시설의 소유자에게 법 제72조제2항에 따른 오염물질수거확인증을 작성하여 발급하여야 한다. 이 경우 오염물질수거확인증의 보관기간에 관하여는 제39조제2항을 준용한다. <개정 2013. 6. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② Any person specified in each subparagraph of Article 37, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall , when collecting and treating pollutants from a marine facility, prepare and issue a Certificate of Confirmation of Pollutant Collection pursuant to Article 72, Paragraph 2 of the Act to the owner of the said marine facility. In this case , Article 39, Paragraph 2 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the retention period of the Certificate of Confirmation of Pollutant Collection . <Amended June 19, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제37조제2항에 따라 「폐기물관리법」 제25조제8항에 따른 폐기물처리업자(이하 “폐기물처리업자”라 한다)가 제1항 각 호의 오염물질을 수거ㆍ처리하는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 오염물질 인계인수서를 해양시설의 소유자에게 발급하여야 한다. 다만, 「폐기물관리법」 제18조제3항에 따라 오염물질의 인계ㆍ인수에 관한 내용을 같은 법 제45조제2항에 따른 전자정보처리프로그램에 입력한 경우는 그러하지 아니하다. <신설 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where a waste treatment business operator (hereinafter referred to as the “waste treatment business operator”) pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 8 of the Waste Management Act under Article 37 , Paragraph 2 of the Act collects and treats pollutants specified in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1, the operator shall issue a document of transfer and acceptance of pollutants containing the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs to the owner of the marine facility. However, this shall not apply in cases where the details regarding the transfer and acceptance of pollutants have been entered into an electronic information processing program pursuant to Article 45, Paragraph 2 of the same Act pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 3 of the Waste Management Act. <Newly added May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양시설의 소유자(사업장의 명칭 및 대표자를 포함한다)에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the owner of the marine facility (including the name of the business site and the representative)

rows.source_ko: 2. 폐기물처리업자(사업장의 명칭 및 대표자를 포함한다)에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning waste treatment operators (including the name of the business site and the representative)

rows.source_ko: 3. 수거한 오염물질의 종류 및 수거량
rows.text_en: 3. Types and quantities of collected pollutants

rows.source_ko: 4. 오염물질 수거에 참여한 해양시설의 직원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning employees of marine facilities who participated in the collection of pollutants

rows.source_ko: 5. 오염물질 수거일자
rows.text_en: 5. Date of pollutant collection

rows.source_ko: 제21조의2(오염물질저장시설의 변경신고 사항 등) ① 법 제38조제2항 후단에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 중요한 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 21-2 (Matters for Reporting Changes to Pollutant Storage Facilities, etc.) ① The term “important matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” in the latter part of Article 38, Paragraph 2 of the Act refers to any of the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제38조제1항에 따른 오염물질저장시설(이하 “오염물질저장시설”이라 한다) 사업장의 명칭 또는 대표자
rows.text_en: 1. Name or representative of the workplace of the pollutant storage facility (hereinafter referred to as the “pollutant storage facility”) pursuant to Article 38, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 오염물질저장시설의 설치 장소
rows.text_en: 2. Installation site of pollutant storage facility

rows.source_ko: 3. 오염물질저장시설의 규모
rows.text_en: 3. Scale of pollutant storage facilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 오염물질저장시설 운영계획서의 내용
rows.text_en: 4. Contents of the Pollutant Storage Facility Operation Plan

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제38조제3항에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 기간”이란 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 기간을 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 38, Paragraph 3 of the Act , “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the period according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제38조제2항 전단에 따른 신고의 경우: 10일
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of a report pursuant to the first part of Article 38, Paragraph 2 of the Act : 10 days

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제38조제2항 후단에 따른 변경신고의 경우: 5일
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of a notification of change pursuant to the latter part of Article 38, Paragraph 2 of the Act : 5 days
[This Article Newly Inserted June 28, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제21조의3(오염물질저장시설의 설치ㆍ운영 신고서 등) ① 영 제40조의3제1항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 설치ㆍ운영 신고서는 별지 제18호의2서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 21-3 (Report on Installation and Operation of Pollutant Storage Facilities, etc.) ① A report on installation and operation pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 40-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 18-2.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제40조의3제2항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 설치ㆍ운영 변경신고서는 별지 제18호의2서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The notification of change in installation and operation pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 40-3, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 18-2 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제40조의3제3항에 따른 신고증명서는 별지 제18호의3서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The certificate of report pursuant to Article 40-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 18-3.
[This Article Newly Inserted June 28, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제21조의4(오염물질저장시설 신고증명서의 재발급) 영 제40조의3제3항에 따라 발급받은 오염물질저장시설 신고증명서를 잃어버리거나 헐어서 못 쓰게 되어 다시 발급받으려는 자는 별지 제18호의4서식의 오염물질저장시설 신고증명서 재발급 신청서에 해당 신고증명서를 첨부(신고증명서를 잃어버린 경우는 제외한다)하여 지방해양수산청장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 21-4 (Reissuance of Certificate of Reporting of Pollutant Storage Facility) Any person who wishes to have a Certificate of Reporting of Pollutant Storage Facility issued pursuant to Article 40-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree reissued because the certificate has been lost or damaged and is no longer usable shall submit to the head of the regional maritime affairs and fisheries office an application for reissuance of the Certificate of Reporting of Pollutant Storage Facility in the form of Annex 18-4 , attaching the relevant certificate (excluding cases where the certificate has been lost).
[This Article Newly Inserted June 28, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제22조(오염물질관리대장의 기록 및 보존) ① 법 제38조제4항에 따른 오염물질관리대장(이하 “오염물질관리대장”이라 한다)에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 적어야 한다. <개정 2024. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Recording and Preservation of Pollutant Management Register) ① The pollutant management register pursuant to Article 38, Paragraph 4 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “pollutant management register”) shall record the matters of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 28, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 오염물질의 종류 및 발생현황
rows.text_en: 1. Types of pollutants and current status of occurrence

rows.source_ko: 2. 오염물질의 자가처리 및 위탁처리 현황
rows.text_en: 2. Status of Self-Treatment and Outsourced Treatment of Pollutants

rows.source_ko: ② 오염물질관리대장은 별지 제19호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The pollutant management ledger is as in Form No. 19 of the attached document .

rows.source_ko: ③ 오염물질관리대장은 마지막으로 적은 날부터 2년 동안 해당 시설에 보관하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The pollutant management ledger must be kept at the relevant facility for two years from the date of the last entry.

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제38조제4항 전단에 따라 같은 조 제2항에 따른 오염물질저장시설 운영자(이하 “오염물질저장시설 운영자”라 한다)는 오염물질관리대장을 매 분기가 끝나는 날부터 15일 이내에 해양경찰서장에게 제출해야 한다. 이 경우 법 제115조제7항에 따른 전산망을 이용하여 제1항 각 호의 사항을 입력한 경우에는 이를 제출한 것으로 본다. <신설 2024. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ④ Pursuant to the first part of Article 38, Paragraph 4 of the Act , the operator of a pollutant storage facility under Paragraph 2 of the same Article (hereinafter referred to as the “pollutant storage facility operator”) shall submit a pollutant management ledger to the head of the Coast Guard Station within 15 days from the end of each quarter. In this case, if the matters specified in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 have been entered using the computer network pursuant to Article 115, Paragraph 7 of the Act , it shall be deemed that the ledger has been submitted. <Newly added June 28, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제23조(오염물질저장시설의 설치ㆍ운영기준) ① 법 제38조제1항에 따라 시ㆍ도지사 또는 해양환경공단의 이사장이 설치ㆍ운영하는 오염물질저장시설의 설치ㆍ운영기준은 별표 10과 같다. <개정 2024. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Standards for Installation and Operation of Pollutant Storage Facilities) ①The standards for the installation and operation of pollutant storage facilities installed and operated by the Mayor/Do Governor or the Chairperson of the Korea Marine Environment Corporation pursuant to Article 38, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 10. <Amended June 28, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제38조제2항에 따라 오염물질저장시설 운영자가 설치ㆍ운영하는 오염물질저장시설의 설치ㆍ운영기준은 별표 10의2와 같다. <신설 2024. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The installation and operation standards for pollutant storage facilities installed and operated by an operator pursuant to Article 38, Paragraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 10-2 . <Newly added June 28, 2024>
[Wholly revised Oct. 5, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제23조의2(오염물질저장시설 운영자에 대한 행정처분의 세부기준) 법 제38조의3제1항에 따른 오염물질저장시설 운영자에 대한 행정처분의 세부기준은 별표 10의3과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 23-2 (Detailed Standards for Administrative Dispositions against Operators of Pollutant Storage Facilities) The detailed standards for administrative dispositions against operators of pollutant storage facilities pursuant to Article 38-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Table 10-3 .
[This Article Newly Inserted June 28, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제24조(잔류성오염물질의 측정ㆍ조사) ① 해양환경공단의 이사장은 법 제39조제1항 전단에 따라 제5조에 따른 해양환경측정망을 활용하여 매년 잔류성오염물질의 오염도를 측정ㆍ조사하여야 한다. <개정 2011. 9. 29., 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 9. 22., 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Measurement and Investigation of Persistent Organic Pollutants) ① The President of the Korea Marine Environment Corporation shall, in accordance with the first part of Article 39, Paragraph 1 of the Act, measure and investigate the pollution levels of persistent organic pollutants annually by utilizing the marine environment monitoring network under Article 5. <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Sep. 22, 2017; May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 측정ㆍ조사의 항목 및 방법, 측정망의 위치ㆍ구역, 측정ㆍ조사 절차, 그 밖의 필요한 사항은 해양수산부장관이 정하여야 한다. <개정 2011. 9. 29., 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ② The items and methods of measurement and investigation pursuant to Paragraph 1, the locations and areas of measurement networks, the procedures for measurement and investigation, and other necessary matters shall be determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③ 해양수산부장관은 제1항에 따른 측정ㆍ조사결과 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 법 제39조제1항 후단에 따라 관계 중앙행정기관의 장 및 지방자치단체의 장과 공동으로 오염저감대책을 수립하거나 배출원 조사를 하여야 하며, 관계 중앙행정기관의 장에게 필요한 조치를 요청할 수 있다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 24., 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ If the results of the measurement or investigation under Paragraph 1 fall under any of the following subparagraphs, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall, in accordance with the latter part of Article 39, Paragraph 1 of the Act , formulate pollution reduction measures or conduct an investigation of emission sources jointly with the heads of relevant central administrative agencies and local governments, and may request the heads of relevant central administrative agencies to take necessary measures. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 잔류성오염물질의 연평균 오염도가 2년 이상 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시하는 해양퇴적물 관리목표를 초과하는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where the annual average pollution level of persistent organic pollutants exceeds the marine sediment management targets determined and notified by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries for two years or more

rows.source_ko: 2. 「잔류성유기오염물질 관리법」 제2조제2호에 따른 배출시설의 고장ㆍ파손, 그 밖의 사고가 발생하여 잔류성오염물질이 「연안관리법」 제2조제1호에 따른 연안에 배출된 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Where persistent organic pollutants are discharged into the coast as defined in Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Coastal Management Act due to a malfunction, damage, or other accident of a discharge facility pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Persistent Organic Pollutants Management Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「잔류성유기오염물질 관리법」 제16조에 따른 사용중지명령 및 폐쇄명령이 내려진 배출시설이 법 제15조제1항에 따른 환경관리해역 또는 「연안관리법」 제2조제1호에 따른 연안에 위치하는 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Where a discharge facility subject to a suspension of use or closure order pursuant to Article 16 of the Persistent Organic Pollutants Control Act is located in an environmental management sea area pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Act or on the coast pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Coastal Management Act
[Title amended May 1, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제25조(방오시스템의 사용기준ㆍ방법) 해양시설등에서 방오도료 또는 이를 사용한 설비(이하 “방오시스템”이라 한다)를 사용하거나 설치하려고 하는 자는 법 제40조제2항에 따라 다음 각 호의 기준 및 방법에 따라야 한다. <개정 2021. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Standards and Methods for Use of Antifouling Systems) Any person who intends to use or install antifouling paint or equipment using the same (hereinafter referred to as “antifouling system”) in marine facilities, etc. shall comply with the standards and methods set forth in each of the following subparagraphs pursuant to Article 40, Paragraph 2 of the Act. <Amended June 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 생물파괴제로 작용하지 아니하는 수준의 방오시스템을 사용하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: 1. An antifouling system must be used at a level that does not act as a biodegrading agent.

rows.source_ko: 2. 건조 도막(도료 도포막) 안에 총주석함량이 킬로그램당 2천 5백밀리그램 이하로서 화학적 촉매제로 작용하며 생물파괴제로 작용하지 않는 수준의 방오시스템을 사용해야 한다.
rows.text_en: 2. An antifouling system must be used in which the total tin content in the dry film (paint coating) is 2,500 milligrams per kilogram or less, acting as a chemical catalyst and not as a biodegrading agent.

rows.source_ko: 제26조(국가긴급방제계획에 포함되어야 할 오염물질) ① 법 제61조제1항 전단에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 오염물질”이란 다음 각 호의 물질을 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 24., 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Pollutants to be Included in the National Emergency Disaster Response Plan) ① The term “pollutants prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” in the first part of Article 61, Paragraph 1 of the Act refers to the substances listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 기름
rows.text_en: 1. Oil

rows.source_ko: 2. 위험ㆍ유해물질 중 해양경찰청장이 정하여 고시하는 물질
rows.text_en: 2. Among dangerous and hazardous substances, substances designated and notified by the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항제2호에서 “위험ㆍ유해물질”이란 유출될 경우 해양자원이나 생명체에 중대한 위해를 미치거나 해양의 쾌적성 또는 적법한 이용에 중대한 장애를 일으키는 물질로서 유해액체물질 및 포장유해물질과 산적(散積)으로 운송되며, 화재ㆍ폭발 등의 위험이 있는 물질(액화가스류를 포함한다)을 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2, the term “dangerous or hazardous substance” refers to a substance that, if spilled, causes serious harm to marine resources or living organisms or causes serious impediment to the pleasantness or lawful use of the ocean, and includes hazardous liquid substances, packaged hazardous substances, and substances transported in bulk that pose a risk of fire, explosion, etc. (including liquefied gases).

rows.source_ko: 제27조(지역긴급방제실행계획의 수립ㆍ시행) 영 제44조제3항에 따른 지역긴급방제실행계획에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2026. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Establishment and Implementation of Regional Emergency Disaster Prevention Action Plan) The Regional Emergency Disaster Prevention Action Plan pursuant to Article 44, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall include the following matters: <Amended July 1, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 오염물질별 사고위험평가 및 대응전략
rows.text_en: 1. Accident Risk Assessment and Response Strategies by Pollutant

rows.source_ko: 2. 방제조직의 운영 및 사고유형별 방제조치 계획
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of Disaster Response Organization and Disaster Response Plan by Accident Type

rows.source_ko: 3. 방제장비, 자재, 약제 등의 동원 및 보급ㆍ지원 계획
rows.text_en: 3. Plan for Mobilization and Supply/Support of Control Equipment, Materials, Chemicals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 해양오염 방지 및 방제에 관한 교육ㆍ훈련(민ㆍ관 합동방제훈련을 포함한다)의 실시
rows.text_en: 4. Implementation of education and training regarding marine pollution prevention and control (including joint public-private response training)

rows.source_ko: 5. 방제관련 해역 특성정보 및 자료
rows.text_en: 5. Information and Data on Sea Area Characteristics Related to Pollution Control

rows.source_ko: 제28조(방제대책본부의 조치사항 등 보고) 법 제62조제2항에 따라 해양경찰청장이 해양수산부장관에게 보고하는 방제대책본부의 조치사항 및 결과에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2011. 9. 29., 2013. 3. 24., 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Reporting of Measures, etc. by the Disaster Response Headquarters) Pursuant to Article 62, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the measures and results of the Disaster Response Headquarters reported by the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall include the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Sep. 29, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양오염사고 발생개요
rows.text_en: 1. Overview of the Marine Pollution Incident

rows.source_ko: 2. 방제대책본부의 구성 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the composition and operation of the Disaster Response Headquarters

rows.source_ko: 3. 해양오염현황
rows.text_en: 3. Current Status of Marine Pollution

rows.source_ko: 4. 방제조치 현황 및 조치결과
rows.text_en: 4. Status of Pest Control Measures and Results

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other necessary matters
[Title amended Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 28, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제29조(해양시설로부터의 오염물질 배출신고) ① 법 제63조에 따라 해양시설로부터의 오염물질 배출을 신고하려는 자는 서면ㆍ구술ㆍ전화 또는 무선통신 등을 이용하여 신속하게 하여야 하며, 그 신고사항은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 29 (Reporting of Discharge of Pollutants from Marine Facilities) ① Any person who intends to report the discharge of pollutants from marine facilities pursuant to Article 63 of the Act shall do so promptly in writing, orally, by telephone, or by wireless communication, etc., and the matters to be reported are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양오염사고의 발생일시ㆍ장소 및 원인
rows.text_en: 1. Date, time, location, and cause of the marine pollution accident

rows.source_ko: 2. 배출된 오염물질의 종류, 추정량 및 확산상황과 응급조치상황
rows.text_en: 2. Types, estimated quantities, and diffusion status of emitted pollutants, and emergency response status

rows.source_ko: 3. 사고선박 또는 시설의 명칭, 종류 및 규모
rows.text_en: 3. Name, type, and size of the accident vessel or facility

rows.source_ko: 4. 해면상태 및 기상상태
rows.text_en: 4. Sea level and weather conditions

rows.source_ko: ② 해양경찰청장 또는 해양경찰서장 외의 자는 제1항에 따른 신고를 받은 경우에는 지체 없이 그 내용을 해양경찰청장 또는 해양경찰서장에게 알려야 한다. <개정 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② Any person other than the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard or the head of a Coast Guard station shall, upon receiving a report under Paragraph 1, notify the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard or the head of the Coast Guard station of the contents thereof without delay. <Amended Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제30조(오염물질의 감식ㆍ분석) 해양경찰청장은 오염물질이 해양에 배출된 경우에는 그 규명에 필요한 감식ㆍ분석을 할 수 있다. 이 경우 오염물질의 규명절차 및 관리 등 필요한 사항은 해양경찰청장이 정한다. <개정 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 30 (Identification and Analysis of Pollutants) Where pollutants have been discharged into the ocean, the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard may conduct identification and analysis necessary for their identification. In such cases, necessary matters, including the procedures for identifying and managing pollutants, shall be determined by the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard . <Amended Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제30조의2(방제조치 명령) 해양경찰서장은 법 제64조제3항에 따라 방제조치 명령을 할 때에는 별지 제19호의2서식의 방제조치 명령서를 내줘야 한다. 다만, 긴급한 때에는 구두로 방제조치 명령을 할 수 있으며, 이 경우에는 사후에 지체 없이 그 명령서를 내줘야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 30-2 (Order for Disaster Prevention Measures) When the head of a Korea Coast Guard station issues an order for disaster prevention measures pursuant to Article 64, Paragraph 3 of the Act, he/she shall issue a written order for disaster prevention measures in the form of Annex 19-2. However, in urgent cases, an order for disaster prevention measures may be issued orally, and in such cases, a written order shall be issued without delay thereafter.
[This Article Newly Inserted Jan. 7, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제31조(오염물질의 배출방지를 위한 조치) 해양시설의 소유자는 법 제65조제1항에 따라 오염물질의 배출방지를 위한 다음 각 호의 조치를 취하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 31 (Measures for Prevention of Discharge of Pollutants) The owner of a marine facility shall take the following measures to prevent the discharge of pollutants in accordance with Article 65, Paragraph 1 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: 1. 파손ㆍ화재 등의 사고인 경우에는 오염물질을 다른 선박이나 해양시설로 옮겨 싣는 조치 또는 손상부위의 긴급수리, 침수 또는 배출방지를 위하여 필요한 조치
rows.text_en: 1. In the event of an accident such as damage or fire, measures to transfer pollutants to another vessel or marine facility, emergency repairs to damaged parts, or necessary measures to prevent flooding or discharge

rows.source_ko: 2. 침몰이 예상되는 경우에는 오염물질의 배출 우려가 있는 모든 부위를 막는 조치
rows.text_en: 2. In the event that sinking is anticipated, measures to block all parts at risk of pollutant discharge.

rows.source_ko: 3. 불을 끄는 중에 생긴 오염물질의 경우에는 다른 선박이나 해양시설로 옮겨 싣는 조치 또는 배출방지를 위하여 필요한 조치
rows.text_en: 3. In the case of pollutants generated during firefighting, measures to transfer them to other vessels or marine facilities, or necessary measures to prevent discharge.

rows.source_ko: 4. 제1호부터 제3호까지의 규정에 따른 조치에도 불구하고 오염물질이 배출될 우려가 있는 경우 배출 또는 확산방지를 위하여 필요한 조치
rows.text_en: 4. Measures necessary to prevent discharge or diffusion in cases where there is a risk of pollutant discharge notwithstanding the measures under Subparagraphs 1 through 3

rows.source_ko: 제31조의2(해양오염 취약선박 위험성 평가) ① 법 제65조제2항에 따른 해양오염 취약선박(이하 “해양오염 취약선박”이라 한다)에 대한 위험성 평가의 평가 항목은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 31-2 (Risk Assessment of Vessels Vulnerable to Marine Pollution) ① The assessment items for the risk assessment of vessels vulnerable to marine pollution pursuant to Article 65, Paragraph 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “vessels vulnerable to marine pollution”) are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 선박의 제원 및 운항 이력
rows.text_en: 1. Vessel Specifications and Operational History

rows.source_ko: 2. 선체의 구조 및 안전 상태
rows.text_en: 2. Structure and Safety Condition of the Hull

rows.source_ko: 3. 선박 내 오염물질의 적재 현황
rows.text_en: 3. Status of Contaminant Loading on Ship

rows.source_ko: 4. 선박의 관리 체계
rows.text_en: 4. Ship Management System

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 오염물질 배출 방지를 위해 평가가 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters requiring evaluation to prevent the discharge of pollutants

rows.source_ko: ② 해양경찰청장은 법 제65조제2항에 따라 위험성 평가를 하는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 종합적으로 고려하여 오염물질이 해양으로 배출될 위험성을 판단해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard conducts a risk assessment pursuant to Article 65, Paragraph 2 of the Act , he/she shall determine the risk of pollutants being discharged into the ocean by comprehensively considering the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 오염물질의 유출 가능성
rows.text_en: 1. Possibility of pollutant leakage

rows.source_ko: 2. 오염물질이 유출될 경우 예상되는 피해의 정도
rows.text_en: 2. Expected extent of damage in the event of a pollutant spill

rows.source_ko: 3. 선박 관리의 적절성
rows.text_en: 3. Adequacy of Ship Management
[This Article Newly Inserted July 1, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제32조(해양시설의 자재ㆍ약제 비치기준 등) ① 법 제66조제1항에 따라 오염물질의 방제ㆍ방지를 위한 자재 및 약제(이하 “자재ㆍ약제”라 한다)를 갖추어두어야 하는 해양시설은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 32 (Standards for Stocking Materials and Chemicals in Marine Facilities, etc.) ① Marine facilities required to stock materials and chemicals for the control and prevention of pollutants (hereinafter referred to as “materials and chemicals”) pursuant to Article 66, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 오염물질을 300킬로리터 이상 저장할 수 있는 시설
rows.text_en: 1. Facilities capable of storing more than 300 kiloliters of pollutants

rows.source_ko: 2. 총톤수 100톤 이상의 유조선을 계류하기 위한 계류시설
rows.text_en: 2. Mooring facilities for mooring oil tankers with a gross tonnage of 100 tons or more

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제66조제3항에 따라 해양시설 안에 갖추어두어야 하는 자재ㆍ약제의 비치기준은 별표 11과 같다. 다만, 유처리제ㆍ유흡착재 또는 유겔화제(기름을 굳게 하는 물질)의 경우에는 해당 해양시설에 기준량의 10퍼센트 이상을 갖추어두고, 나머지는 제33조에 따른 보관시설에 보관할 수 있다. <개정 2021. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The standards for the stocking of materials and chemicals to be kept within marine facilities pursuant to Article 66 , Paragraph 3 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 11. However, in the case of oil dispersants, oil absorbents, or oil gelling agents (substances that solidify oil), at least 10 percent of the standard amount must be kept in the relevant marine facility, and the remainder may be stored in storage facilities pursuant to Article 33. <Amended June 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항 단서에 따라 보관시설에 유처리제 등을 보관하는 경우에는 그 사실을 증명하는 서류를 해당 해양시설에 갖추어두어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where oil dispersants, etc. are stored in a storage facility pursuant to the proviso of Paragraph 2, documents proving such fact must be kept at the relevant marine facility.

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제67조제1항에 따라 방제선 또는 방제장비(이하 “방제선등”이라 한다)를 배치ㆍ설치하거나 같은 조 제2항에 따라 위탁하여 배치ㆍ설치한 경우에는 법 제66조에 따른 자재ㆍ약제 등을 갖추어둔 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ④ In cases where a disaster prevention vessel or disaster prevention equipment (hereinafter referred to as “disaster prevention vessel, etc.”) is deployed or installed pursuant to Article 67, Paragraph 1 of the Act , or deployed or installed by entrustment pursuant to Paragraph 2 of the same Article , it shall be deemed that materials, agents, etc. pursuant to Article 66 of the Act have been provided.

rows.source_ko: 제33조(보관시설의 자재ㆍ약제 비치기준 등) ① 법 제66조제3항에 따른 보관시설의 범위는 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2010. 1. 12., 2011. 9. 29., 2013. 6. 19., 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 33 (Standards for Stocking Materials and Pharmaceuticals in Storage Facilities, etc.) ① The scope of storage facilities pursuant to Article 66, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended Jan. 12, 2010; Sep. 29, 2011; Jun. 19, 2013; May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양시설의 소유자가 해양시설에 갖추어두어야 할 자재ㆍ약제를 보관하기 위하여 해당 항만에 설치한 시설(공동으로 설치한 것을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Facilities installed in the relevant port by the owner of a marine facility to store materials and drugs required to be kept in the marine facility (including those installed jointly)

rows.source_ko: 2. 항만관리청이 항만시설, 어항시설의 방제를 위한 자재ㆍ약제를 보관하기 위하여 「항만법」 제3조제1항에 따른 항만 및 「어촌ㆍ어항법」 제2조제3호에 따른 어항에 설치한 시설
rows.text_en: 2. Facilities installed by the Port Management Authority in ports pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Port Act and in fishing ports pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Fishing Village and Fishing Port Act for the purpose of storing materials and chemicals for pest control in port facilities and fishing port facilities.

rows.source_ko: 3. 해양환경공단이 법 제97조에 따른 사업을 위하여 해양오염방제에 필요한 자재ㆍ약제를 보관할 목적으로 해당 항만에 설치한 시설
rows.text_en: 3. Facilities installed by the Korea Marine Environment Corporation in the relevant port for the purpose of storing materials and chemicals necessary for marine pollution control for projects under Article 97 of the Act

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제66조제3항에 따라 항만관리청이 보관시설에 갖추어두어야 할 자재ㆍ약제의 비치기준은 별표 12와 같으며, 제1항의 보관시설의 시설기준 및 운영기준은 별표 13과 같다. <개정 2011. 9. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 66, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the standards for the stocking of materials and chemicals that the Port Management Authority must keep in storage facilities are as set forth in Annex 12 , and the facility and operation standards for the storage facilities referred to in Paragraph 1 are as set forth in Annex 13. <Amended Sep. 29, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 제34조(방제선등의 배치해역) ① 법 제67조제1항제3호에 따른 기름저장시설의 소유자는 해당 시설이 위치한 항만구역에 방제선등을 설치하여야 한다. 다만, 비축용ㆍ비상용 기름저장시설의 소유자는 해당 시설에서 기름이 배출되는 경우 3시간 이내에 도달할 수 있는 곳에 배치할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 34 (Deployment Area for Oil Spill Response Vessels, etc.) ① The owner of an oil storage facility pursuant to Article 67 , Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Act shall install oil spill response vessels, etc. in the port area where the facility is located. However, the owner of a stockpiling or emergency oil storage facility may deploy them in a location where they can reach within 3 hours in the event that oil is discharged from the facility.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제67조제2항에 따라 방제선등을 공동으로 배치ㆍ설치한 자와 해양환경공단에 배치ㆍ설치를 위탁한 자는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 증거서류를 해당 기름저장시설의 사업소에 갖추어 두어야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Persons who have jointly deployed or installed oil spill response vessels, etc. pursuant to Article 67, Paragraph 2 of the Act , and persons who have entrusted such deployment or installation to the Korea Marine Environment Corporation, shall keep documentary evidence containing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs at the business office of the relevant oil storage facility. <Amended May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 공동배치를 한 자 : 배치한 방제선등의 목록 및 제원
rows.text_en: 1. Person who carried out joint deployment: List and specifications of deployed control vessels, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 배치ㆍ설치를 위탁한 자
rows.text_en: 2. The person who entrusted the placement and installation

rows.source_ko: 가. 위탁자의 성명 또는 상호
rows.text_en: a. Name or trade name of the consignor

rows.source_ko: 나. 수탁자의 성명 또는 상호
rows.text_en: B. Name or trade name of the trustee

rows.source_ko: 다. 수탁기간
rows.text_en: C. Trusteeship Period

rows.source_ko: 라. 위탁자와 수탁자 간의 통신방법
rows.text_en: D. Method of communication between the trustee and the trustee

rows.source_ko: 제35조(방제비용의 청구) 영 제50조에 따른 방제비용의 청구는 별지 제20호서식에 따른다. <개정 2010. 1. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 35 (Claim for Pest Control Costs) Claims for pest control costs pursuant to Article 50 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 20 of the Attached Form . <Amended Jan. 12, 2010>

rows.source_ko: 제35조의2(해양자율방제대) ① 해양경찰서장은 법 제68조의2제1항에 따른 해양자율방제대(이하 “해양자율방제대”라 한다)를 「수산업협동조합법」 제15조에 따른 어촌계(이하 이 조에서 “어촌계”라 한다) 단위로 구성ㆍ운영한다. 이 경우 해양경찰서장은 별표 13의2에 따른 시설 및 방제자재를 갖춰야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 35-2 (Marine Autonomous Disaster Response Team) ① The head of a Korea Coast Guard station shall organize andoperate a Marine Autonomous Disaster Response Team pursuant to Article 68-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Marine Autonomous Disaster Response Team”) on the unit of a fishing village association pursuant to Article 15 of the Fisheries Cooperatives Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Fishing Village Association”) in this Article. In this case, the head of a Korea Coast Guard stationshall be equipped with facilities and disaster response materials in accordance with Annex 13-2 .

rows.source_ko: ② 해양경찰서장은 관할구역에 주소ㆍ거소 또는 사업장이 있는 사람 중 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람이 희망하는 경우 해양자율방제대의 구성원(이하 “해양자율방제대원”이라 한다)으로 임명할 수 있다. <개정 2023. 12. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The head of a Coast Guard station may appoint a person who has an address, residence, or business establishment within the jurisdictional area and falls under any of the following subparagraphs as a member of the Marine Autonomous Disaster Response Team (hereinafter referred to as “Marine Autonomous Disaster Response Team Member”) if such person so desires. <Amended Dec. 28, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 어촌계에 소속된 어업인(「수산업법」 제2조제10호에 따른 어업인을 말한다. 이하 같다)
rows.text_en: 1. Fishermen belonging to a fishing village association ( referring to fishermen under Article 2, Item 10 of the Fisheries Act ; hereinafter the same applies)

rows.source_ko: 2. 신체가 건강하고 협동정신이 강한 사람
rows.text_en: 2. A person who is physically healthy and has a strong cooperative spirit.

rows.source_ko: 3. 해양자율방제대 활동에 필요한 선박 또는 장비를 보유한 사람
rows.text_en: 3. Persons possessing vessels or equipment necessary for the activities of the Marine Autonomous Disaster Response Team

rows.source_ko: ③ 해양경찰서장은 법 제68조의2제3항에 따라 해양자율방제대와 해양자율방제대원에게 다음 각 호의 경비를 지급할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the Coast Guard may pay the following expenses to the Marine Autonomous Disaster Response Team and its members in accordance with Article 68-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 1. 출동경비
rows.text_en: 1. Dispatch security

rows.source_ko: 2. 교육ㆍ훈련경비
rows.text_en: 2. Education and training expenses

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제68조의2제4항에 따라 해양경찰서장이 지급하는 재해보상의 종류 및 기준은 별표 13의3과 같다.
rows.text_en: ④ The types and standards of disaster compensation paid by the head of the Coast Guard pursuant to Article 68-2 , Paragraph 4 of the Act are as set forth in Table 13-3 .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 해양자율방제대의 임무는 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The duties of the Marine Autonomous Disaster Prevention Team are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양오염사고 발생 시 해양경찰의 해양오염방제업무 보조
rows.text_en: 1. Assisting the Coast Guard in marine pollution control operations in the event of a marine pollution accident

rows.source_ko: 2. 해양오염사고 현장의 안전을 위한 지원활동
rows.text_en: 2. Support activities for safety at marine pollution accident sites

rows.source_ko: 3. 방제역량 강화를 위한 교육ㆍ훈련에의 참여
rows.text_en: 3. Participation in education and training to strengthen pest control capabilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 지역의 자율적인 해양오염방제 기능 강화를 위해 해양경찰청장이 필요하다고 인정하는 임무
rows.text_en: 4. Other missions deemed necessary by the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard to strengthen autonomous marine pollution control functions in the region

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제1항부터 제5항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 해양자율방제대의 구성ㆍ운영 및 임무에 관한 세부사항은 해양경찰청장이 정한다.
